Recall by instance size

Weeds only. A weeder that misses small weeds misses the ones worth killing — a weed is cheapest to destroy before it establishes. One aggregate recall hides where the cliff is.

Crop safety

UNMEASURED, not passing. This split has no onion_plant ground truth, so nothing here says the crop is safe. A model trained without onion instances cannot predict the crop at all.

Reading this honestly

If train and val come from the same recording, these frames share its lighting, soil, growth stage and often the same individual plants. That makes this a sanity check that training works — not evidence of generalisation. Only a held-out session can support that.
